name: Hamayuu Ebino
source: Ebino is from Miyazaki Prefecture; her name comes from Ebino, Miyazaki, and the Japanese name for the Poisonbulb flower. She has a bit of an evil-streak and is maniacal about many hobbies. She likes to call Tsukasa "Darling", and is the shortest of the bride candidates.
